description: The statutory rates and parameters the engine uses (14 jurisdictions, effective dates, application modes, sources, verification status), filterable by jurisdiction, key and date. Free.

date.description: Only the rows in force on this date (default: every row, all periods)

key.description: Row key (e.g. sbd_rate, business_limit, passive_income_grind); omit for all keys

scope.description: corporate = the T2 / CO-17 rows (default set before 0.3.0); personal = T1 / TP-1 rows; payroll = contributions and employer levies. Omit for all.
